lines: I'll file that apology carefully. The follow-up is the part worth reading.
I'll not erase the record. I may add this to it.
Your apology is noted. The revision will be in your behavior.
I dislike repeat offenses in any edition.
Words can clarify. They can't replace the missing page.
I'll not close the book on you yet. Don't make me regret the bookmark.
The statement is clear. The evidence must follow.
I accept the correction. Now avoid making an errata list.
I was wrong. I would rather say it plainly than dress it up.
That came out sharper than it should have. I am sorry.
